_readme: BRYME Matchweek Chronicles. Original cartoon storylines only. Scores and named scorers must already exist in content/results.json. Speech bubbles are fictional cartoon-squad chatter, not quotes from real people. Artwork lives in /assets/img/sports/comics/ and is original generated illustration — no broadcast stills, no player photographs, no club badges in the drawings.

stories.headline: The title defence opens with a clean sheet

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: Friday night at the Emirates. A new league season, a promoted visitor, and a cartoon squad that has decided three points is the only acceptable souvenir.
panels.bubble: New season. Same red shirts. Let's take the first three and go home.

panels.title: The first one
panels.caption: The opening goal goes in. BRYME does not have a sourced scorer for this match, so the comic does not invent a name — only the scoreline that BBC Sport later confirmed.
panels.bubble: That's one. Don't get clever. Get two.

panels.title: The second
panels.caption: Coventry spend the rest of the half chasing a side that has already decided the evening's direction.
panels.bubble: They're running. We're passing. Keep it boring.

panels.title: The third
panels.caption: A third goal lands. The title defence has a first win. It is a start, not a carved-in-stone statement.
panels.bubble: Three-nil. Write it down. Then forget it until next week.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Arsenal 3–0 Coventry City. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 21 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Clean sheet. Three points. Next.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: Played 1, won 1. Several Premier League sides still have their opening match in front of them, so the table is a snapshot, not a throne.
panels.bubble: We're on three. So is anyone else who already won. Sit down.

panels.title: Hull’s Premier League return
panels.caption: Home tunnel. Amber flags. Nine years away. United stay on the grass.
panels.bubble: Nobody expects us to be here.

panels.title: Kick-off → 17′ Ajayi
panels.caption: McBurnie saved. Rebound. Semi Ajayi. 1–0.
panels.bubble: We were supposed to control this game.

panels.title: Dorgu booked → 38′ Mendy
panels.caption: Yellow on 34′. Slater’s free-kick, Mendy’s header. 2–0.
panels.bubble: Another set piece.

panels.title: Half-time: two rooms
panels.caption: Stripes only on the left. Red only on the right. Rashford laces up.
panels.bubble: Marcus, get ready.

panels.title: Rashford on
panels.caption: United own the ball. Hull own the score. 72% possession.
panels.bubble: We have 72%.

panels.title: The changes
panels.caption: Ajayi and Mendy off to applause. Sesko and Mainoo on.
panels.bubble: You need two.

panels.title: Late push · full time
panels.caption: Tzolakis keeps Mbeumo out. Millar yellow 90+6. Whistle.

panels.title: The Tigers are back
panels.caption: Ajayi 17. Mendy 38. Possession does not keep the points.
panels.bubble: Welcome back to the Premier League.

stories.headline: A Saturday evening that only travelled one way

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: West London, 17:30, Sky Sports. Tottenham travel across the city expecting a contest. Brentford have prepared a different evening.
panels.bubble: Short hop. Get the three. Don't make it a story.

panels.title: 12 minutes
panels.caption: Keane Lewis-Potter, 12'. The first one. BBC Sport has the name and the minute. The cartoon away end has its head in its hands.
panels.bubble: Already? We just sat down.

panels.title: 33 and 48
panels.caption: Vitaly Janelt on 33', Michael Kayode on 48'. Three different names, one direction of traffic.
panels.bubble: Three. Three different people. This is a parade.

panels.title: The reaction
panels.caption: The cartoon away bench stares at the scoreboard as if it personally betrayed them. It did not. Brentford did.
panels.bubble: Don't look at the board. Look at the ball. It's over there.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Brentford 3–0 Tottenham Hotspur. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 22 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Zero shots of comfort. Zero points. Next week is not this week, and that is the only good news.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: Played 1, lost 1, three conceded. Several sides have not even kicked off yet. Tottenham already know how the opening weekend felt.
panels.bubble: Put us wherever the lost column lives. We'll climb later.

stories.headline: A midweek start, two goals, no drama invented

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: Wednesday night at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano. Málaga visit. The cartoon red-and-white shirts treat it as a first chore of a long league.
panels.bubble: Midweek. Home. Two goals would be polite.

panels.title: The first
panels.caption: A first goal goes in. BRYME does not have a sourced scorer for this match, so the comic does not name one.
panels.bubble: One-nil. Keep the door shut.

panels.title: The second
panels.caption: A second follows. The evening settles into the kind of home win that does not need a novel, only a scoreline.
panels.bubble: Two. That's the polite number.

panels.title: The touchline
panels.caption: The cartoon dugout folds its arms. A first league win is in the book. Sunday's visitors will be harder.
panels.bubble: Good. Now recover. Villarreal is not Málaga.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Atlético Madrid 2–0 Málaga. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 19 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Three points. Clean sheet. File it.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: Played 1, won 1. La Liga's opening weeks are staggered, so the table is a running tally of sourced results, not an official jornada close.
panels.bubble: We're on three. Don't frame it.

stories.headline: Stolen at the death in Barcelona

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: Saturday night in Barcelona. Madrid are the visitors. The cartoon white shirts expect control. The evening has other plans.
panels.bubble: Away. Get the three. Don't make it late.

panels.title: 9 minutes
panels.caption: Jude Bellingham, 9'. Quick. BBC Sport has the minute. The comic does not need to decorate it.
panels.bubble: Early. Good. Now don't fall asleep.

panels.title: 30 minutes
panels.caption: Cala, 30'. Level. The home side have a way back into their own evening.
panels.bubble: We were winning. We were literally just winning.

panels.title: 90 minutes
panels.caption: Carlos Espí, 90'. Late. The cartoon white shirts finally breathe. A first league win of the season, taken at the death.
panels.bubble: Now. Now you score. Typical.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Espanyol 1–2 Real Madrid. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 22 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Ugly. Fine. Three points do not have to be pretty.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: A first sourced league win is on the board. Real Madrid's numbered 'matchweek 1' fixture is still ahead — the calendar is not the same thing as the clock.
panels.bubble: Win first. Argue about jornada numbers later.

stories.headline: Four goals, one reply, a loud San Siro start

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: Saturday at San Siro. Monza visit. The cartoon nerazzurri treat the opener as a home chore that should end with a smile.
panels.bubble: Home. First night. Make it four if they let us.

panels.title: 6 minutes
panels.caption: Hakan Çalhanoğlu, 6'. The evening starts on time.
panels.bubble: Six minutes. That's the tempo.

panels.title: 29 minutes
panels.caption: Gustavo Varela, 29'. Monza have a reply. The cartoon home end briefly remembers that football is not a procession by law.
panels.bubble: One-one? Who said they could do that?

panels.title: The second half
panels.caption: Piotr Zieliński 48', Francesco Pio Esposito 55', Yann Aurel Bisseck 63'. Three more, all sourced from BBC Sport. The procession resumes.
panels.bubble: Right. That's more like four.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Inter Milan 4–1 Monza. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 22 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Four-one. File it under 'start'.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: Played 1, won 1, four scored. Several Serie A sides still have their first match on Sunday or Monday.
panels.bubble: We're on three. The rest of the city can catch up tomorrow.

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: Saturday night in Genoa. Napoli travel. The cartoon sky-blue shirts are patient. They will need to be.
panels.bubble: Away. Don't panic early. The goal will come.

panels.title: A long evening
panels.caption: For a long time the comic has no goal to draw. That is not a plot hole. It is the match.
panels.bubble: Still 0-0. Keep running. They'll blink.

panels.title: 82 minutes
panels.caption: Kevin De Bruyne, 82'. Late, and sourced. The evening finally tilts.
panels.bubble: There. I told you they'd blink.

panels.title: 87 minutes
panels.caption: Antonio Vergara, 87'. A second, four minutes later. The cartoon away end finds its voice.
panels.bubble: Two. Now it looks like a plan.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Genoa 0–2 Napoli. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 22 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Patience. Then two. That's an away win.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: Played 1, won 1, clean sheet. A first Serie A night that refused to become a story until the last ten minutes.
panels.bubble: Three points. No need to frame the last ten. Just take them.

stories.headline: A Friday night at the Vélodrome, settled after the break

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: Friday in Marseille. Strasbourg visit. The cartoon home end wants a statement. The first half declines to provide one.
panels.bubble: Friday. Home. Don't let them leave with a point.

panels.title: The first half
panels.caption: Goalless at the break. The comic sits on its hands. Then the second half begins.
panels.bubble: Still 0-0. Fine. Now start.

panels.title: Gouiri, twice
panels.caption: Amine Gouiri, 46' and 68'. A brace, both sourced from BBC Sport. The Vélodrome remembers how this is supposed to feel.
panels.bubble: Two for him. Keep serving.

panels.title: Late, then later
panels.caption: Emran Soglo Abdallah 89', Pierre-Emile Højbjerg 90+6'. Four-nil by the time the referee has had enough.
panels.bubble: Four. That's a Friday.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Olympique de Marseille 4–0 RC Strasbourg. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 21 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Clean sheet. Four goals. Put it on the wall and go to sleep.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: Played 1, won 1, four scored, none conceded. Ligue 1's opening weekend is still being played.
panels.bubble: We're on three. Paris play Sunday. That's their problem.

stories.headline: A clean away night in Toulouse

panels.title: Before kickoff
panels.caption: Saturday in Toulouse. Lyon travel. The cartoon visitors want a first-night win and no souvenirs left behind.
panels.bubble: Away. Two goals. Don't give them one.

panels.title: The first
panels.caption: A first goal goes in. BRYME does not have a sourced scorer for this match, so the comic does not invent a name.
panels.bubble: One-nil. Stay mean.

panels.title: The second
panels.caption: A second follows. The evening becomes the kind of away win that looks simple only after it is finished.
panels.bubble: Two. That's the number we asked for.

panels.title: The touchline
panels.caption: The cartoon away bench stays standing until the whistle. A clean sheet is still available and they would like to keep it.
panels.bubble: Don't get cute. Take the zero.

panels.title: Full time
panels.caption: Toulouse 0–2 Olympique Lyonnais. Confirmed via BBC Sport on 22 August 2026.
panels.bubble: Two-nil away. First box ticked.

panels.title: The board
panels.caption: Played 1, won 1, none conceded. Sunday's Ligue 1 programme is still ahead of several rivals.
panels.bubble: Three points. Let Paris and Monaco play tomorrow.
